visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black t-shirt and a woman in a brown tank top with a pink cardigan sit indoors. The woman has her arms crossed and a stern, squinted facial expression, looking straight ahead, while the man looks at her sideways with a nervous, wide-eyed gaze. (2) In a living room setting, a man brings two small water bottles to a low marble table where two large cases of water are stacked. The woman approaches, effortlessly lifts both heavy cases of water simultaneously with a neutral expression, and walks quickly out of frame. (3) In a warehouse-like studio, the man stands holding a red sweater and a Chinese Erhu instrument. The woman suddenly streaks across the frame at an extremely high speed, appearing as a blur of her pink cardigan as she disappears to the right. (4) Back in a domestic setting, the man sits next to the woman on a couch, gesturing with his hands and moving his mouth as if speaking to her. The woman keeps her arms crossed, looking away with a cold, unblinking expression, completely ignoring him. (5) In a bedroom with white linens, the woman lies down in checkered pajamas. As the man reaches out to touch her shoulder, she instantly executes a Jiu-Jitsu-style leg lock move, sweeping him onto the floor with a swift, defensive motion. (6) The pair sits at a wooden table eating from white takeout containers. The woman eats rice and meat quickly with a fork, showing no loss of appetite despite her mood, while the man eats cautiously and observes her.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic sketch that satirizes the trope of a partner's heightened abilities or 'superpowers' when angry. It uses visual hyperbole, such as super-strength and super-speed, paired with an ironic, cheerful retro song to create humor out of a tense relational situation.
